title: Wildlife sanctuary
text:
20.02.1151 Wildlife sanctuary.
"Wildlife sanctuary" means as an area of land, water, and the air space above which is managed to protect wildlife species, their habitat, and the ecosystem(s) these wildlife species depend upon. For the purpose of this ordinance, the term "wildlife sanctuary" is synonymous with "wildlife refuge", "wildlife preserve", and "nature preserve". This designation shall only apply to property that is zoned natural open space.
(Ord. No. 17306, § 1, 4-6-2010)
